title: Main tips to remember: 1. Questions create conversation! Get to know your interviewer 2. Have 4-5 pre-prepared stories for any question they ask 3. Have 3 questions prepared to ask them 4. Send a follow up email  Main sections of an interview: 1. Intros: a good time to get to know your interviewer and their background. Ask questions - how long have they been w the company, where’d they go to school, etc.  2. Your actual interview questions: have 4-5 preprepared stories that will help you answer any situational/behavioral question. Mold your story to the question and highlight relevant pieces  3. Close out: Ask your preprepared questions for the interview. Say thank you. Discuss next steps  4. SEND A FOLLOW UP!!: Say thank you for the opportunity, mention how XYZ skills make you a good fit, mention something personal from your interviewer. This is max 24 business hrs after the interview.  Good luck!!!! #interview #interviewtips #jobsearch #careerfair
